incident: During owner-free continuity reconciliation, an unsafe repository-write probe accidentally replaced KEIRIN_CURRENT_STATE.json content on the active research branch.

recovery.method: Force-reset only the active research branch reference to the exact known-good preincident commit after Fresh Read confirmed the accidental commit chain contained only CURRENT repair/probe mutations above that checkpoint.

durable_lesson: Never probe repository write capability by replacing an authoritative CURRENT/RULE/LEDGER file. Write-capability probes must use a dedicated non-authoritative disposable probe path or issue comment. Authoritative-file mutation requires a fully prepared replacement payload and a Fresh Read of the exact current blob immediately before update.
